module.name: Observability Stack
module.description: Deploys Fluent Bit (HSL UDP receiver) and Loki (log aggregation) for BNK iRule telemetry. Pattern from lanner-bnk-poc.

required.reason: Namespaces must exist before deploying observability

optional.name: loki_retention_hours
optional.description: Number of hours to retain logs in Loki

optional.name: fluentbit_hsl_port
optional.description: UDP port for Fluent Bit HSL receiver

key_outputs.name: fluentbit_service_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the Fluent Bit HSL service

key_outputs.name: fluentbit_hsl_port
key_outputs.description: UDP port for HSL log ingestion

key_outputs.name: observability_ready
key_outputs.description: Flag indicating observability stack is deployed
